# Hello! Xin Chào!

I’m Le-Huynh Truc-Ly, an environmental health researcher who loves using data, statistics, and R to understand environmental exposures and their impacts on human health.
I use R to automate research workflows, create cool visuals, and build open-source software because life’s too short for repetitive tasks, and science should be open.
When I’m not hanging out with dataframes, I’m sketching, cooking, or finding creative ways to keep my hands busy.
This site is a collection of my research, projects, random thoughts, and technical notes from my coding journey. 
Most posts are personal notes to my future self, who I’m sure has forgotten many things.

*P.S. Hey, future me! Debugging code again? Read this site before setting your computer on fire!*

:::
